meta.subject: fixed GPR reset bug, fixed lsu dup loading, fixed riscv-tests

en.summary: Mixed commit with several unrelated fixes. The clearest fault-injection target is the GPR-stage repair that prevents the architectural zero register from being written during early writeback before reset/bring-up completes.
why_it_counts: The chosen primary fix is in the core register-file write path, not in host software.
The patch explicitly adds an rd != 0 guard and comments that r0 could be written before reset completes.
Even though the commit is mixed, this specific DUT fix is isolated and reversible.
disqualifiers: The commit also edits CI scripts, runtime code, debug prints, CSR names, and a large LSU refactor, so it is not a single-purpose bug-fix commit.
The LSU-related hunks likely contain real DUT fixes too, but they are broader and less isolated than the GPR fix.
evidence: In hw/rtl/VX_gpr_stage.v, write_enable is introduced as writeback_if.valid && (writeback_if.rd != 0).
That new write_enable replaces raw writeback_if.valid on every GPR RAM write enable.
The added comment states the intent directly: ensure r0 never gets written, which can happen before reset.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Architectural zero registers must remain hardwired to zero regardless of reset timing or speculative writeback activity. If the register file write-enable path does not explicitly suppress writes to register zero, early writeback traffic can corrupt x0 before the rest of the machine state stabilizes, causing pervasive architectural failures that are hard to localize.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: zero-register write suppression in register-file writeback
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Any writeback event targets architectural register zero during reset, bring-up, or other early cycles when spurious writeback activity is still possible.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the guard that blocks writes to architectural register zero.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop zero-register term from register-file write enable
portability_notes: Apply this only to DUTs that architecturally define x0 or an equivalent hardwired-zero register.
The bug can be injected in scalar, vector, or per-thread register files as long as writes share a central enable path.
Even if the source commit mentions reset, the same fault is still valid whenever any unintended write to x0 can occur.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the writeback path that drives register-file RAM write enables.
Identify the condition that suppresses writes when the destination register index is zero.
Delete that destination-register-zero check so any valid writeback can write x0.
Keep the destination address calculation unchanged so the fault specifically corrupts the zero register invariant.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: GPR-stage write-enable generation for architectural x0
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix introduces a write_enable signal that blocks writeback when rd == 0, and uses it on all GPR RAM write ports.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Replace write_enable with raw writeback_if.valid, or remove the (writeback_if.rd != 0) term from the write-enable expression.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Register zero can become nonzero after an early writeback, causing widespread architectural misexecution and incorrect operand reads in later instructions.
evidence_for_injection: The GPR-stage hunk is compact and self-contained, unlike the larger LSU refactor in the same commit.
The code comment explicitly ties the fix to an r0 corruption scenario before reset completes.
Every GPR RAM instance was switched to the new guarded enable, confirming the bug affected the actual write path.
notes: This second-pass entry keeps the commit as dut_bugfix but intentionally uses the GPR x0 repair as the primary injectable mechanism.
The broader LSU changes still support the classification as a mixed DUT-fix commit.

zh.summary: 这是一个包含多类改动的混合提交。最清晰、最适合作为 fault injection 目标的是 GPR 阶段的修复：它阻止在 reset/bring-up 尚未稳定时，早期 writeback 把架构零寄存器写坏。
why_it_counts: 选定的主缺陷位于核心寄存器文件的写路径，而不是宿主软件层。
补丁显式加入了 rd != 0 保护，并在注释中说明 reset 前后可能把 r0 写坏。
虽然整次提交很混杂，但这一处 DUT 修复本身局部、可逆。
disqualifiers: 该提交还修改了 CI 脚本、runtime 代码、调试打印、CSR 名称以及较大的 LSU 重构，因此它不是单一目的的 bug-fix 提交。
LSU 相关代码里大概率也包含真实 DUT 修复，但它们比 GPR 修复更大、更不易隔离。
evidence: 在 hw/rtl/VX_gpr_stage.v 中，引入了 write_enable = writeback_if.valid && (writeback_if.rd != 0)。
之后每个 GPR RAM 的写使能都从原来的 writeback_if.valid 改成了新的 write_enable。
新增注释直接说明了意图：确保 r0 永远不会被写，这种情况可能在 reset 完成前发生。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 架构零寄存器必须始终保持为零，不应受到 reset 时序或投机 writeback 活动的影响。如果寄存器文件写使能路径没有显式禁止对寄存器零的写入，早期 writeback 流量就可能在整机状态尚未稳定前破坏 x0，从而引发难以定位的全局性架构错误。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 寄存器文件写回中的零寄存器写抑制
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 任意 writeback 事件在 reset、bring-up 或其他早期周期把目标寄存器指向架构零寄存器。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删除阻止写入架构零寄存器的保护条件。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 从寄存器文件写使能中去掉零寄存器保护项
portability_notes: 只应映射到架构上定义了 x0 或等价硬连零寄存器的 DUT。
只要写路径共享中心使能逻辑，这个故障就可以注入到标量、向量或按线程分片的寄存器文件中。
虽然源提交提到了 reset，但只要存在对 x0 的意外写，这个故障同样成立。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到驱动寄存器文件 RAM 写使能的 writeback 路径。
定位其中用于在目标寄存器索引为零时抑制写入的条件项。
删除这项目的寄存器为零检查，使任何有效 writeback 都能写入 x0。
保持目标地址计算不变，让故障集中表现为“零寄存器不再恒为零”。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: GPR stage 中针对架构 x0 的写使能生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复引入了一个 write_enable 信号，在 rd == 0 时阻止 writeback，并把它应用到所有 GPR RAM 写端口。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 write_enable 改回原始的 writeback_if.valid，或从写使能表达式中移除 (writeback_if.rd != 0) 这一项。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 零寄存器会在早期 writeback 后变成非零，随后导致大范围的架构级错误执行和错误操作数读取。
evidence_for_injection: 与同一提交中较大的 LSU 重构相比，GPR 这一处修改更紧凑、可独立分析。
代码注释明确把修复与“reset 完成前 r0 被写坏”的场景联系起来。
所有 GPR RAM 实例都切换到了新的受保护写使能，说明实际错误就在写路径上。
notes: 二次评审保留该提交为 dut_bugfix，但把 GPR 的 x0 修复作为主注入机制。
更大的 LSU 改动仍然支持它属于“混合型 DUT 修复提交”的判断。
